input.quote: (g) Revisions. During the term of this Agreement, the Licensor shall make available to Licensee any Revisions of the Software or Documentation at no extra charge, subject to limitations explicitly set forth in this Agreement. The Licensor will make such available to the Licensee when the Licensor makes such Revisions generally available to its other licensees.
input.rationale:
The Agreement contains no most-favoured-nation obligation on us. Searches for MFN/"no less favo(u)rable"/best-price/other-customer language return nothing, and the pricing and payment provisions (per-trade fee bands at §§ p0059-p0063, time of payment, rebate shares at p0076 and the Supplemental Payments revenue share at p0078) are fixed commercial terms with no obligation for us to extend the Licensor terms given to any third party or to match third-party offers. The only "other licensees" reference (p0094) runs in our favour: the Licensor must make Revisions available to us when it makes them generally available to its other licensees. The one third-party-matching mechanic in the document is the Article XXII Right of First Refusal (p0139) over a sale of substantially all our assets or a merger — an M&A/change-of-control right rather than an MFN on commercial or pricing terms, so it is properly assessed under the change-of-control/assignment rule and is not double-flagged here. This meets the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer), so no redline is proposed.</parationale>
